title: House by the Grove
description: A nature-led home with simple forms, shaded edges, and room to slow down.

cover.alt: Cartoon-style concept illustration of a cozy timber living room and shaded veranda surrounded by forest trees; not a photograph

gallery.alt: Cartoon 3D timber cabin with a pitched roof, shaded entrance, and surrounding trees
gallery.title: A simple forest retreat
gallery.description: A pitched roof, timber-like cladding, and a planted approach explore a modest weekend home that sits comfortably beside the grove.

gallery.title: Living at the shaded edge
gallery.description: An open timber canopy and easy seating extend everyday living outdoors, creating a sheltered place to enjoy the surrounding greenery.

gallery.title: Reading beside the grove
gallery.description: Timber shelving, a quiet chair, and green views make space for slower afternoons without adding unnecessary furniture.

gallery.alt: Cartoon cabin bedroom with timber furniture, forest-green bedding, and leafy window views
gallery.title: A restful timber bedroom
gallery.description: Natural-looking wood tones and forest greens tie the sleeping space to the retreat's nature-led material palette.

gallery.description: A shared timber table and gentle overhead light support relaxed meals, with garden-facing daylight keeping the room connected to its setting.
